tal-a30-p01 · verses 30.1-30.10 · WITHHELD

atha yathocitamantrakadambakaṃ trikakulakramayogi nirūpyate / tāvadvimarśānārūḍhadhiyāṃ tātsiddhaye kramāt pratibuddhā hi te mantrā vimarśaikasvabhāvakāḥ / svatantrasyaiva ciddhāmnaḥ svātantryāt kartṛtāmayāḥ yamāviśanti cācāryaṃ taṃ tādātmyanirūḍhitaḥ / svatantrīkurvate yānti karaṇānyapi kartṛtām ādhāraśaktau hrīṃ pṛthvīprabhṛtau tu catuṣṭaye / kṣlāṃ kṣvīṃ vaṃ kṣamiti prāhuḥ kramādvarṇacatuṣṭayam haṃ nāle yaṃ tathā raṃ laṃ vaṃ dharmādicatuṣṭaye / ṛṃ ṝṃ ḷṃ ḷḷṃ catuṣke ca viparītakramādbhavet oṃ auṃ hastrayamityetadvidyāmāyākalātraye / anusvāravisargau ca vidyeśeśvaratattvayoḥ kādibhāntāḥ kesareṣu prāṇo@ṣṭasvarasaṃyutaḥ / sabinduko daleṣvaṣṭasvatha svaṃ nāma dīpitam śaktīnāṃ navakasya syācchaṣasā maṇḍalatraye / sabindukāḥ kṣmaṃ prete jraṃ śūlaśṛṅgeṣu kalpayet pṛthagāsanapūjāyāṃ kramānmantrā ime smṛtāḥ / saṃkṣepapūjane tu prāgādyamantyaṃ ca bījakam ādāyādhāraśaktyādiśūlaśṛṅgāntamarcayet / agnimārutapṛthvyambusaṣaṣṭhasvarabindukam
